title: 第79章 利益共享，北上之约
content_zh:
第79章 利益共享，北上之约-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

上一章

存书签

下一章

三号研发楼签约结束后，张江这边没有马上散场。

方锐坐在会议室角落，端着纸杯喝水，半杯水喝了十分钟。

他这趟来上海，原本只想把合同签了，把方家的半导体原材料项目塞进张江核心区。

结果半路杀出中投信达，文件压门，副市长亲临，齐家亮相。

整个过程比他过去三十多年见过的所有场面都刺激。

齐衡倒是自在。

签完约，他把西装外套往椅背上一搭，跟陈启明要了最新一版场地规划图。

“这个仓储节点，不能放太远。”

他拿笔在图上圈了一下。

“原材料入库以后，检测、分拣、配送，三个环节最好压在同一条动线上。”

“理论上能跑，实际上一到雨天，物流车堵在园区门口，产线经理骂娘骂到嗓子哑。”

陈启明点头。

“我建议把二号楼一层的部分空间也纳进来，做预检测区。”

叶知秋在旁边翻资料。

“二号楼一层目前有两家企业在谈续租，合同还没签。可以协调。”

齐衡转头看林川。

“林川，二号楼一层能动吗？”

称呼已经变了。

从林总，到林川，只隔了一场仗。

林川看着图纸。

“能动，但不能白给。”

齐衡乐了。

“你这人谈朋友归谈朋友，算盘珠子该响还是响。”

“亲兄弟也要看租金表。”

“行。”齐衡拿笔敲了敲桌面，

“二号楼一层我们按市场价租，另外加一个设备共享条款。芯海那边如果要做材料稳定性测试，我们开放一部分实验室资源。”

林川点头。

“这个可以写进补充协议。”

齐衡看向齐韵。

“你那边有没有意见？”

“二号楼一层可以纳入，但设备共享条款要限定范围。核心配方和工艺参数不能开放。”

齐衡摊手。

“你看，我妹一开口就是风控。”

林川接话。

“风控不是坏事。很多项目死，不是死在没钱，是死在第一天觉得自己永远不会出事。”

下午四点半，补拍的合影结束。

宣传口的人心满意足地走了，备案口的人抱着文件下楼去加急录入。

会议室里剩下九州和齐家的人。

顾城姗姗来迟。

After the signing of the No. 3 R&D Building was completed, Zhang Jiang did not leave immediately.

Fang Rui sat in the corner of the conference room, holding a paper cup and drinking water. He drank half of the water for ten minutes.

When he came to Shanghai this time, he originally just wanted to sign the contract and put the Fang family's semiconductor raw material project into the core area of ​​Zhangjiang.

As a result, CIC Xinda came out halfway, documents were pressed at the door, the deputy mayor came in person, and the Qi family made an appearance.

The whole process was more exciting than anything he had seen in the past thirty years.

Qi Heng felt at ease.

After signing the contract, he put his suit jacket on the back of the chair and asked Chen Qiming for the latest site plan.

"This storage node cannot be placed too far away."

He took a pen and circled the picture.

"After the raw materials are put into storage, it is best to move the three links of testing, sorting, and distribution on the same line."

"Theoretically, we can run away, but in fact, when it rains, the logistics trucks are blocked at the entrance of the park, and the production line manager curses until he becomes hoarse."

Chen Qiming nodded.

"I suggest that part of the first floor of Building 2 be included as a pre-testing area."

Ye Zhiqiu was flipping through information beside him.

"There are currently two companies on the first floor of Building 2 who are negotiating to renew their lease, but the contract has not been signed yet. We can coordinate."

Qi Heng turned to look at Lin Chuan.

"Linchuan, can the first floor of Building 2 be moved?"

The title has changed.

From Mr. Lin to Lin Chuan, there was only a battle.

Lin Chuan looked at the drawings.

"You can move, but you can't give it away for free."

Qi Heng was happy.

"You talk about friends, you talk about friends, the abacus beads should ring or not."

"Brothers also need to read the rent schedule."

"Okay." Qi Heng tapped the pen on the table.

"We rent the first floor of Building 2 at the market price, plus an equipment sharing clause. If Chipsea needs to do material stability testing, we will open up some laboratory resources."

Lin Chuan nodded.

"This can be written into the supplementary agreement."

Qi Heng looked at Qi Yun.

"Do you have any objections over there?"

"The first floor of Building 2 can be included, but the equipment sharing terms must be limited. The core formula and process parameters cannot be opened."

Qi Heng spread his hands.

"You see, my sister is always risk-controlled as soon as she opens her mouth."

Lin Chuan answered.

"Risk control is not a bad thing. Many projects die not because they have no money, but because they feel that nothing will happen to them on the first day."

At 4:30 p.m., the additional photo shoot ended.

The person at the publicity desk left with satisfaction, and the person at the filing desk went downstairs with the documents in hand to rush the entry.

Only people from Jiuzhou and Qi family were left in the conference room.

Gu Cheng arrived late.
